title: Better Mansions
description: A complete remake of woodland mansions updating every room to have new blocks, features and loot.
body:
#                                  BETTER MANSIONS

*A vanilla style overhaul of the classic woodland mansion!*

This datapack makes the woodland mansion better with much needed changes, such as newer blocks, loot and decorations. The floors are made of spruce planks and the carpets have a new color scheme to make it feel a little more like highblock halls from Minecraft Dungeons.

![The Halls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/555c73e231932ec0c795f8fb7a4ac0e34b207e49_0.webp)
